gaps: No single-file North-Indian studio video of a full 3 hours: the longest proper studio uploads are 2 h 14 min (Bihar, Pal's Creation) and 1 h 53 min (Mirzapur). Longer masters are usually split into Part 1/2/3 (Arora Baba Lucknow), and the only 3.6 h upload (YS-OvkxRp-k) is an unedited personal file.

YouTube has no videos titled 'static video'. The static format is the traditional full-length video (static/tripod coverage, no grade), so it is covered by the UP and Bihar traditional films plus the traditional-vs-cinematic explainers.
North-Indian 'candid video' as a named format is rare and gets few views (the term is mainly South-Indian); only Zero Gravity's North-Indian candid film fits, at 1.6k views.
Ritual-specific films with good views exist only for haldi, mehndi, sangeet and pheras; none were found for tilak, matkor or dwar-puja outside full-length videos. That belongs to the Bihar track.

yt-dlp -J description/chapter lookups returned no data for 9 of 10 borderline videos (likely rate-limiting), so region and ritual tags are inferred from titles and channels. They should be confirmed when frames are sampled.
Celebrity references (Anushka-Virat in Italy, Kiara-Sidharth in Jaisalmer) are high-budget; useful for structure and pacing, not as a budget-realistic look for a Patna studio.
